title: Transition compatibility of scalar units under finite evaluation
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l, an embedding iota:E to L, a scheme W, coefficient-extension systems A [stage3-pur-extension-reduction-data], finite scalar evaluations rho with IsCoefficientScalarEvaluationUnit [stage3-pur-scalar-cochain-evaluation], and a coefficient E-system N. Define u_n(x)=rho_n inverse applied to the finite scalar-adjunction unit of x at level n. For n<=m and sections x at level m and y at level n over U, if the E-system transition sends x to y (HEq), then the L-system transition of A.scalar.model.E(N) sends u_m(x) to u_n(y) (HEq). No flatness or exactness is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary evaluation unit equation, use the normalized restriction-evaluation section formula, and cancel rho to identify u_n(x) with the actual system scalar-adjunction unit section.

For any morphism of ring sheaves, the adjunction unit is a module-sheaf morphism. Its presheaf naturality for the horizontal sequence-site arrow identifies the image of its upper unit section with its lower unit applied to the presheaf restriction of x.

The coefficient transition section formula identifies these presheaf maps with finite system transitions. Substitute the assumed compatibility of x and y, and use the lower unit comparison in reverse.

proof_origin.place: lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules (03D7); sequence site preceding sites-cohomology.tex 0941. Fully proved auxiliary calculation for stage3-pur-extension-association-successor.

theorem evaluatedUnitSection_transition
    (A : CoefficientExtensionSystems l E L ι W)
    (ρ : ∀ n : ℕ, A.scalar.model.E ⋙ coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n ≅
      coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E)
    (hρ : IsCoefficientScalarEvaluationUnit l E L ι W A ρ)
    (N : coefficientSequenceModules l E W) {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (x : ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W m).obj N).val.obj U)
    (y : ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).obj N).val.obj U)
    (hxy : HEq (((coefficientSequenceTransition l E W h).app N).val.app U x) y) :
    HEq (((coefficientSequenceTransition l L W h).app
      (A.scalar.model.E.obj N)).val.app U
        (evaluatedUnitSection l E L ι W A ρ N m U x))
      (evaluatedUnitSection l E L ι W A ρ N n U y)
